newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber unchanged in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber unchanged in dull trade.

text.p: Indonesian rubber prices were mostly unchanged in late trading as selling pressure mounted in the wake of poor demand, dealers said.
They said consumer demand was absent while dealers from Singapore were heard bidding in Palembang for tyre-grade SIR20, but no deals had been done yet.

"I heard Singapore agents were bidding at 55.25-55.50 cents/lb but sellers were asking for 55.75 cents," one dealer said. Another dealer said February shipment SIR20 was done in Palembang at 56.00 cents/lb fob Palembang and that U.S. dealers were bidding at 55.50 cents.
Dealers said January SIR20 was on offer at 56.00-56.25 cents/lb fob Medan, 55.50-55.75 cents fob Padang and Surabaya, 55.125 cents fob Jambi and 55.00 cents fob Pontianak.
One dealer said he had shipped 1,500 tonnes of wet latex to the United States from Medan where it was quoted at 2,200-2,300 rupiah/kg. December RSS1 was quoted at around 128/kg fob Medan.
